turns.replyTail:
on an order I just placed?

Can I cancel an order after placing it, and is there a time window?

No—once an order is placed, it moves into processing right away, so there isn’t a cancellation window. We’re unable to cancel or modify orders after they’re submitted.

Can I add an item to an order I already placed?
